payload.title: Atmospheric Data: Nino 3 SST Index
payload.summary: This notebook analyzes the Nino 3 Sea Surface Temperature (SST) Index using wavelet analysis to generate power and phase spectra. It involves downloading and organizing SST data, applying wavelet transforms, and visualizing the results. The notebook uses libraries such as PyWavelets, Matplotlib, and Pandas to process and plot the data. The outputs include visualizations of the power and phase spectra, which help in understanding the frequency components of the SST data.
goals: Understand wavelet analysis in the context of atmospheric data.
Learn to download and organize Nino 3 SST data.
Generate and interpret wavelet power and phase spectra.
